window.status_observation_note: Run creation window is fixed; current run statuses were read during the fetch interval, not as historical end-of-window snapshots.

scope.source: GitHub REST list repository workflow runs; existing ordinary HTTPS connection

limits: Workflow success is not model inference, body acquisition, semantic review, independent evidence, or end-to-end operating success.
Skipped CPU workflow runs are retained as skipped, never converted to completed CPU reads.
Main workflow_dispatch runs are manual and excluded from the main automatic denominator.
An absent or unfinished conclusion is not treated as failure or success.
If unfinished runs exist, observed terminal success/failure totals are lower bounds for final eventual outcomes.
API retrieval truncation, if any, makes aggregate counts lower bounds for the creation window.
No secret/token values, logs, source originals, artifacts, actor identities or private payloads were read or persisted.

failure_skip_classification_reuse.interpretation: Prior exact-run metadata classification may be reused only for shared unchanged attempts. New IDs have workflow metadata only and are not independently job/log classified.
